Body.Content:
You can subscribe to Azure Active Directory Premium starting today.  Azure Active Directory Premium subscribers can leverage:
  • Self-service password reset
  • Self-service group management
  • Group-based application access management
  • Multi-factor authentication
  • Customized branding
  • Reporting, alerting and analytics
Learn more about Azure Active Direct Premium (including how to subscribe) on the Active Directory team blog.
